descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in the Product Management team to partner with the Business.

As a Vice President of Product Management in wholesale lending services team, you will lead the strategy and delivery of digital solutions that transform our wholesale lending business.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve product vision, multi-year strategy, and roadmap, aligning to business priorities, regulatory/controls requirements, and customer outcomes.
  • Lead people management: hire, coach, develop, and performance-manage product talent; set operating cadence, standards, and career growth plans.
  • Establish and run program governance (operating model, decision forums, intake/prioritization, dependency management, risk/issue management, and execution reporting).
  • Provide data insights for leadership: define KPI frameworks/OKRs, build executive-level dashboards, translate metrics into narrative, and drive decisions with evidence.
  • Direct solution discovery with cross-functional partners (engineering, design, data, operations, controls) to identify scalable solutions and validate value.
  • Lead product planning and delivery across portfolios/releases—ensuring scope clarity, sequencing, and timely launches with measurable benefits.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and controls to define target-state workflows, requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and customer value.
  • Apply Agile-at-scale practices to improve throughput and predictability; remove impediments and manage trade-offs across competing priorities.
  • Drive change management and end-user adoption: stakeholder mapping, comms/training plans, enablement materials, feedback loops, and adoption measurement.
  • Ensure quality and readiness through test management and automation, production verification, and post-release monitoring; drive continuous improvement via root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering to ensure secure, resilient delivery and alignment to architecture, data, and platform standards.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, IT, or related field
  • Demonstrated leadership as a VP/Senior Product Manager/Product Lead delivering digital transformation in financial services (wholesale lending).
  • Strong understanding of wholesale lending processes, digital technologies, and risk/controls considerations in regulated environments.
  • Proven people leadership experience (managing PM/PO teams), including coaching, operating cadence, and talent development.
  • Strong change management capability to drive adoption and measure behavior change/outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, organization, and presentation skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and Agile tooling (e.g., Jira/Confluence or equivalent).

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Expertise across the product lifecycle: discovery → delivery → launch → adoption → optimization.
  • Strong data literacy: KPI/OKR design, dashboarding, insight generation, and executive storytelling to influence decisions.
  • Experience leading program governance and cross-functional execution across multiple workstreams and dependencies.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

🚀 We are hiring: Co-Founder & Chief Product Officer (CPO)


📍 Location: Bengaluru / Mumbai / Delhi NCR

Compensation: Significant founder-level equity + Competitive salary + Long-term wealth creation opportunity


About Minipix:

Minipix is building a vernacular-first micro-drama platform for Bharat. We believe the next wave of digital entertainment will come from Tier 2, Tier 3, and rural India, not English-speaking metro audiences.

We are looking for a Co-Founder & CPO to help build the product, team, and company from the ground up.


🛠️ What You Will Own

Product Vision & Strategy: Define the long-term roadmap, translate Bharat consumer insights into product experiences, and build a habit-forming platform that drives engagement and retention.


Growth & Monetisation: Design user acquisition, engagement, and retention loops. Build gamification systems and develop monetisation models (Micro-transactions, Sachet pricing, Subscriptions, and Hybrid models). Optimise key metrics like retention, DAU, and LTV.


Product, Engineering & Design Leadership: Build and lead product, engineering, and design functions. Create lightweight, scalable products for low-end Android devices and ensure an exceptional user experience for first-time internet users.


Company Building: Participate in strategic decision-making as a co-founder, shape culture, recruit world-class talent, and act as the face of the company to raise funds from top-tier VCs.


👤 Who You Are

Proven Consumer Product Leader: 10–12+ years of PM experience, with a track record of scaling consumer mobile apps to millions of users. Backgrounds in OTT, short video, social media, gaming, or consumer internet are highly preferred.


Deep Understanding of Bharat: Strong intuition for Tier 2/3 consumer behaviour, regional content consumption patterns, multilingual audiences, and empathy for low-bandwidth/low-end device environments.


Exceptional Communicator & Storyteller: Able to communicate product vision clearly to investors, founders, and teams, translating user feedback into actionable requirements.


Founder Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity, possessing a fierce bias for action, rapid experimentation, and a focus on outcomes over processes.


🎁 Why Join?

Founder-Level Ownership: Significant equity stake and a direct hand in shaping company strategy.


Massive Market Opportunity: Build for the next 500 million internet users and create a new entertainment category.


Build from Day One: Leave a lasting impact by creating systems, processes, and culture from scratch.


Partner with an Ambitious Founder: Co-create the vision and execution roadmap with a highly driven partner.


🎯 Ideal Background: High-scale consumer internet, OTT, short-video, gaming, or audio streaming.


📧 Interested or know someone who fits?

DM me directly or drop a line at

brijesh@minipix.in

to start the conversation!

title: Vice President of Product
description: About the Company We are a fast-growing U.S.-based consumer lending fintech company redefining how consumers access credit and manage their financial lives. Our mission is to simplify and democratize financial access through smart, data-driven digital solutions. Role Overview We are seeking a Vice President of Product to lead our India-based product organization. This leader will manage a team of 10–15 high-performing Product Managers and play a critical role in defining and delivering our global product vision. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product strategist, skilled communicator, and inspiring leader who thrives at the intersection of technology, business, and user experience. Key Responsibilities • Drive the end-to-end product strategy, vision, and execution for our consumer lending and digital financial products. • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10–15 Product Managers to create a high-performance product culture. • Partner closely with global executives, engineering, design, and analytics to deliver best-in class fintech experiences across full customer life cycle (including but not limited to application stage, delinquency management, and returning customer strategy). • Translate the company's strategic goals into clear product roadmaps and measurable outcomes. • Oversee product lifecycle management—from concept to launch, iteration, and scale. • Leverage data and user insights to drive decisions that enhance product performance and customer satisfaction. • Stay current with fintech trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to ensure product innovation. • Collaborate with U.S. stakeholders to ensure strong communication and alignment across global teams. US experience will be a plus. • Proven track record of building and scaling digital products in fintech, digital lending, or e commerce ecosystems. • Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities with a data-driven decision-making approach. • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills across global teams. • Hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work in fast-paced, evolving environments. • Deep understanding of technologies in fintech systems, APIs, cloud platforms, and user experience design. descriptionHtml:
About the Company

We are a fast-growing U.S.-based consumer lending fintech company redefining how consumers access credit and manage their financial lives. Our mission is to simplify and democratize financial access through smart, data-driven digital solutions.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Vice President of Product to lead our India-based product organization. This leader will manage a team of 10–15 high-performing Product Managers and play a critical role in defining and delivering our global product vision. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product strategist, skilled communicator, and inspiring leader who thrives at the intersection of technology, business, and user experience.


Key Responsibilities

• Drive the end-to-end product strategy, vision, and execution for our consumer lending and digital financial products.

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10–15 Product Managers to create a high-performance product culture.

• Partner closely with global executives, engineering, design, and analytics to deliver best-in class fintech experiences across full customer life cycle (including but not limited to application stage, delinquency management, and returning customer strategy).

• Translate the company's strategic goals into clear product roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

• Oversee product lifecycle management—from concept to launch, iteration, and scale.

• Leverage data and user insights to drive decisions that enhance product performance and customer satisfaction.

• Stay current with fintech trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to ensure product innovation.

• Collaborate with U.S. stakeholders to ensure strong communication and alignment across global teams.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree from a reputed institution (MBA or equivalent preferred).

• 10+ years of experience in Product Management, with at least 5 years leading product teams. US experience will be a plus.

• Proven track record of building and scaling digital products in fintech, digital lending, or e commerce ecosystems.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities with a data-driven decision-making approach.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills across global teams.

• Hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work in fast-paced, evolving environments.

• Deep understanding of technologies in fintech systems, APIs, cloud platforms, and user experience design.


Why Join Us

• Opportunity to influence a global product vision from India.

• Work with world-class technology and leadership teams.

• High-impact role in a mission-driven fintech shaping the future of digital lending.

• Competitive compensation, benefits, and flexibility in a remote-first environment.

About the Role

Our client is seeking a highly entrepreneurial and technically strong Head of Product & Commercialisation to lead an AI-enabled B2B SaaS platform in the ESG, Sustainability, and LegalTech space. The product is already live, funded, and solving emerging challenges across large digital platforms.

This is a founder-facing leadership role with end-to-end ownership of product strategy, technical product direction, commercialization, partnerships, and go-to-market execution. The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping product vision, driving adoption, and preparing the business for scale.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive product strategy, roadmap, positioning, packaging, and commercialization.
  • Lead product innovation through customer discovery, market research, and feature ideation.
  • Define and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies and product launches.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to define technical requirements, APIs, integrations, workflows, and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and execution plans.
  • Build relationships with ecosystem partners, agencies, and strategic stakeholders.
  • Leverage customer feedback, market insights, and product data to drive decision-making.
  • Support business growth, market expansion, and long-term scaling initiatives.


Required Skills

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS or Enterprise Software environments.
  • Proven experience building, launching, or scaling SaaS platforms or technology products.
  • Strong Technical Product Management experience, including APIs, integrations, workflows, platform products, and data-driven solutions.
  • Experience owning product strategy, roadmap planning, prioritization, and product lifecycle management.
  • Experience with product launches, GTM strategy, commercialization, and market adoption.
  • Mandatory ESG and Sustainability domain experience.
  • Proven experience working with ESG reporting, Sustainability platforms, ESG ratings, Governance frameworks, Compliance solutions, or related ESG-focused products.
  • Strong customer discovery, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work directly with founders and thrive in high-growth, fast-paced, and ambiguous environments.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, or intelligent workflow platforms.
  • Experience with LegalTech, RegTech, ComplianceTech, Governance, Risk, or regulatory platforms.
  • Experience with marketplace, ecosystem, platform, or merchant-facing products.
  • Background in product marketing, pricing strategy, partnerships, or international product launches.


Why Consider This Opportunity

  • Founder-level ownership and influence.
  • Product already live and funded — not an idea-stage startup.
  • Opportunity to build and scale an AI-powered ESG & Sustainability SaaS platform.
  • Small, focused team with significant growth potential.
  • Direct impact on product direction, commercialization, and company growth.


About YMinds.AI

YMinds.AI is a specialist talent partner helping startups and high-growth companies hire exceptional talent across Product, Engineering, AI, Data, and Digital functions.

Head of Product, Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, B2B SaaS, Product Strategy, Product Roadmap, GTM, Commercialisation, ESG, Sustainability, ESG Reporting, Enterprise Software, AI Products, LegalTech, RegTech

You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

About SAP Business Network

At SAP Business Network, we strive to hire amazing people, engage them, and maintain a diverse workforce. Inclusion, collaboration, and respect for the individual are central to our values.

SAP Business Network is the largest B2B commerce and collaboration platform in the world, connecting millions of trading partners across procurement, logistics, asset management, and supply chain ecosystems. We are building the “Network of Intelligent Enterprises” – a unified, open, AI-powered business network that transforms how companies collaborate with their suppliers, logistics providers, contract manufacturers, and asset operators.

The Role

We are seeking an exceptional Head of Product Management for SAP Business Network Asset Collaboration (BNAC) to define and scale SAP’s next-generation asset collaboration platform. This role will own the end-to-end product strategy for BNAC, driving how asset-intensive industries (e.g., energy, utilities, manufacturing, aerospace & defense, chemicals) collaborate across asset lifecycles, partners, and ecosystems.

This is a market-making leadership role, not a feature-factory position. You will shape how SAP Business Network evolves into the leading platform for multi-enterprise asset visibility, collaboration, and intelligence — spanning maintenance, reliability, sustainability, compliance, and asset-centric supply chains.

You will lead a globally distributed team of senior product managers, partner deeply with engineering, design, and go-to-market leaders, and work directly with strategic customers to co-innovate differentiated capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and own the multi-year product vision and roadmap for BNAC, aligned with SAP’s broader Business Network and SCM strategy.
  • Establish BNAC as the market-leading platform for multi-enterprise asset collaboration, spanning asset lifecycle management, maintenance collaboration, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Translate customer, industry, and ecosystem needs into differentiated, scalable product capabilities.

Product-Led Growth & Business Impact

  • Drive product-led growth by embedding adoption loops, network effects, and expansion paths into the BNAC experience.
  • Own growth metrics including customer adoption, engagement, expansion revenue, retention, and monetization of BNAC capabilities.
  • Partner with sales, marketing, and customer success to create compelling value propositions, packaging, and go-to-market motions.
  • Identify and incubate new revenue streams across asset data services, analytics, sustainability, and partner-enabled ecosystems.

Customer & Ecosystem Leadership

  • Engage directly with strategic customers, industry consortia, and partners to shape requirements, secure design partnerships, and co-innovate.
  • Represent BNAC in executive briefings, customer councils, industry events, and analyst engagements.
  • Drive a strong ecosystem strategy across OEMs, MRO providers, asset operators, and digital solution partners.

Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional execution across engineering, UX, data, and platform teams in a highly matrixed, global environment.
  • Ensure disciplined delivery of roadmap commitments with high quality, scalability, and security.
  • Establish clear product operating rhythms (OKRs, planning cycles, roadmap governance, prioritization frameworks).

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing global product organization with strong product craft, business acumen, and customer obsession.
  • Set a clear culture of accountability, empowerment, and ownership, with single-threaded leaders for major initiatives.
  • Coach product leaders on strategy, executive communication, and cross-functional influence.
  • Drive performance management, succession planning, and long-term capability building for the BNAC product team.

Market & Innovation Leadership

  • Monitor emerging trends across asset management, Industry 4.0, AI, sustainability, and network platforms.
  • Translate technology innovation (AI, analytics, digital twins, IoT integration) into actionable product opportunities.
  • Maintain a sharp competitive perspective and continuously refine BNAC’s differentiated positioning.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including leadership of enterprise or B2B platform products.
  • Deep domain expertise in asset management and asset-intensive industries (e.g., maintenance, reliability, lifecycle management, sustainability, compliance).
  • Proven track record of product-led growth, including driving adoption, monetization, and expansion for platform products.
  • Demonstrated success in building and scaling multi-enterprise or network-based products with strong customer and ecosystem adoption.
  • Strong people leadership experience, including leading senior product managers, building teams, and driving performance and career growth.
  • Exceptional executive presence and communication skills; ability to influence without authority in complex matrixed organizations.
  • Experience working directly with strategic customers and partners in co-innovation or design-partner programs.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect product strategy to revenue, retention, and long-term platform value.
  • Highly adaptable, curious, and comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree strongly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

If you are a visionary product leader energized by defining the future of multi-enterprise asset collaboration, driving product-led growth, and building a world-class product organization, this is your role.

Join SAP Business Network and help build the platform that will power the world’s most resilient, intelligent, and sustainable asset ecosystems.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

We are ethical and compliant

Our leadership credo: Do what’s right. Make SAP better for generations to come. We believe that great leadership extends far beyond the mere pursuit of business goals. We value and foster leadership that is driven with purpose and integrity. Our leaders are role models who uphold SAP’s values and shape SAP’s culture of integrity, by demonstrating and championing ethical and compliant behavior towards all stakeholders.

AI Usage in the Recruitment Process

For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.

Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

descriptionHtml:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.

About the Role:

This isn’t a typical Head of Product role. The expectation is not just to optimize flows, but to fundamentally redefine how trading works for millions of users. You’ll step in at a critical inflection point, owning the next phase of growth for a platform already operating at scale. This role is about expanding into new product frontiers, unlocking new opportunities, and building category-defining trading experiences. It’s a high-impact mandate to drive innovation and shape the future of trading at scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead a Product Management team focused on conceiving, building, and launching user-focused, high-quality products that connect and grow the crypto economy.
  • Work closely with fellow engineering, design, and business leadership to define our product vision and strategy across your product areas, and deliver tangible business outcomes.
  • Identifying and defining KPIs and metrics for the team to set targets and drive overall team performance.
  • Hire, manage, and grow a team of Product Managers and help them to reach their potential.
  • Execute efficiently in a fast-paced, fluid start-up environment where change is constant and creativity is a must.
  • Driving a cross-functional team with engineering, design, support, and marketing to resolve end to end customer issues.

You’ll Excel in This Role If You:

  • Trading experience in the past, with a strong understanding of financial markets—especially Indian markets—and a genuine passion to build and scale products in this space
  • 14+ years of Product Management experience with 4+ years in scaling digital B2C products with customer first focus
  • A deep understanding and appreciation for good design and user experience
  • A track record of building exceptional products that delight your users and produce clear business impact
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects affecting many functions, including product, engineering, finance, compliance, and support.
  • Ability to direct major cross-functional initiatives with effective prioritization and influence
  • Experience collecting both internal and external customer feedback and requests, empathizing with their challenges and opportunities, and prioritizing roadmaps to optimize results
  • Experience in A/B testing and in working with data analytics/data science teams to get metric driven analysis
  • Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
  • Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission
  • Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
  • Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission

Good to have :

  • Experience working in regulated industries collaborating with legal, compliance, and customer support teams
  • Experience in software development or a sound understanding of technical architecture

Hiring Process:

Here’s what your journey with us looks like:

  • Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
  • Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
  • Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
  • Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
  • Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
  • Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

Where We Work:

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bengaluru office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.

Perks That Empower You:

We believe great people deserve great experiences.

  • Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
  • Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
  • Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
  • Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

Ready to Build What’s Next?

If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

Job Description

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Product Owner – Alternatives POD to join our Fund & Investor Services (FIS) Platform team. This role is located in India.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Own end-to-end product strategy and delivery for Alternatives trade flows, aligned to platform priorities and client outcomes.
  • Lead the migration of legacy processing onto ATOMx, driving a clear transition plan and delivery against defined milestones.
  • Drive scalable and standardized processing that increases automation, improves straight-through processing, and reduces manual intervention and operational risk.
  • Define and prioritize the roadmap for Alternatives workflows, including complex asset lifecycles and non-standard events.
  • Partner with Operations, Technology, and Data teams to align delivery to processing models, control requirements, and platform strategy.
  • Act as the key coordination point across dependent PODs and platforms to manage dependencies and ensure consistent adoption of strategic flows.
  • Set clear ownership boundaries between Product, Operations, and Technology to ensure execution discipline and avoid duplication.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Extensive experience in asset servicing or post-trade environments, with strong exposure to Alternatives.
  • Proven experience operating at Director or Senior Vice President level as a Product Owner, Product Lead, or equivalent in a complex, regulated organization.
  • Strong understanding of trade lifecycle processing, particularly for complex or non-standard asset classes.
  • Experience delivering platform migration or transformation programs, including movement from legacy to strategic architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to set clear direction, manage dependencies, and drive delivery across multiple teams.
  • Experience leading senior product or change professionals, with accountability for delivery outcomes.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

About The Team

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

  • America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
  • World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
  • “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

descriptionHtml:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Group Product Manager, Adyen India

As the Group Product Manager for India, you will be a pivotal member of the Adyen India Leadership Team. You will define and execute the product strategy for one of Adyen’s highest-growth regions, ensuring our merchants can expand their reach through locally preferred and innovative payment methods.

This role sits within the global Payments Group. You will collaborate closely with the India Country Head, the Head of Engineering, and global product groups to build the payment engine of the future. You are not just a strategist; you act as the external face of Adyen’s holistic product innovation, engaging with regulators, industry bodies, and C-level executives at the leading merchants to shape the future of the Indian fintech landscape.

What You Will Do

  • Formulate and lead a strategic vision that balances technical acquiring capabilities (eg. Cards, UPI) with the end-to-end merchant experience, ensuring our solutions solve real-world customer problems rather than just meeting technical requirements.
  • You will act as the owner for the India product suite, moving beyond technical delivery to partner with our GTM teams to ensure the commercial viability and market fit of our entire offering. This includes partnering with commercial leaders to understand merchant pain points holistically—from onboarding and pricing to support and retention, ensuring Adyen’s value proposition is seamless across all touchpoints.
  • Serve as the domain expert for the Indian market, identifying new acquiring capabilities and navigating complex regulatory requirements.
  • Work with engineering on resource planning and execution, balancing high-stakes performance and scalability with the rollout of new features.
  • You will build and lead a team of product managers focused on product development for Adyen India, both in your specific areas and with a strong focus on cross-team and solution synergies across Adyen globally.
  • You will work across Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Product teams and closely collaborate with commercial teams such as Sales/AMs, and Product Marketing.
  • You combine strategic leadership with a willingness to dive into the details when needed, taking end-to-end ownership to drive clarity in scope, priorities, and requirements

Who You Are

  • 15+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of shipping high-quality products at scale. Experience in the Indian fintech or financial services sector is preferred.
  • You have autonomously delivered impact by leading and leveraging a portfolio of product managers across product areas.
  • You are effective in finding, growing, leading and retaining talent in product management (5+ years of management experience)
  • You possess a "founder’s mentality," and are comfortable operating at the intersection of product, sales, and operations, and you use data-driven insights to make high-stakes trade-offs that benefit the long-term health of Adyen’s merchant customers.
  • Deep knowledge of the Indian payments ecosystem, including card schemes, UPI, digital wallets, and local "money flow" regulations.
  • Proven ability to translate complex merchant needs into a comprehensive product roadmap that creates a "multiplier effect" across the business, driving both top-line growth and operational efficiency.
  • You succeed in creating a multiplier effect, in connecting with other leaders on opportunities and scaling impactful ways of working.
  • Ability to guide cross-functional teams using analytics to not only drive product decisions but also to quantify the business value and ROI of our localized offerings.
  • Action-Oriented- A relentless bias toward action and tangible outcomes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • You have solid and inspiring communication skills to interact with both internal and external stakeholders as well as the teams working on and contributing to Adyen India.
  • You love to act as a mentor and help guide talent to make optimal decisions.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Summary: Our dynamic HCM Strategy team is seeking an experienced Vice President to drive global, large-scale transformational initiatives. You will be instrumental in leveraging cutting-edge applications and AI to enhance employee experience, deliver quantifiable automation benefits, and build resilient HCM solutions across our firm.

As a Vice President, you will lead strategy, design and delivery of enterprise-wide HCM platforms and solutions critical projects from initiation to completion. You will apply exceptional organizational skills, strategic foresight, and impeccable implementation abilities. A strong focus on integrating systems across the full employee lifecycle – from recruitment to retirement – will be essential. You will collaborate with HCM, technology, and business leaders to define roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and implement scalable solutions aligned with organizational goals.

We are looking for a seasoned professional with a minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in a fast-paced, complex environment, evidenced by a proven track record of successful product management delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Articulate and lead the HCM product vision and strategic roadmap, aligning with HCM and business objectives.
  • Drive the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise-wide HCM systems and tools, from conception to successful implementation.
  • Lead and empower cross-functional teams to deliver complex HCM solutions, ensuring strategic alignment and successful outcomes.
  • Develop robust business cases for new products and enhancements, including financial justification (ROI) and key performance indicators.
  • Champion a data-driven approach by overseeing user research, stakeholder interviews, and continuous product feedback loops to inform decisions.
  • Foster strong partnerships with Data, Engineering, PMO, and HRIS teams to ensure seamless execution and integration.
  • Continuously analyze emerging HCM technology trends and drive innovation into the HCM product strategy and roadmap.
  • Uphold and ensure adherence to governance, data privacy, and regulatory compliance standards across all HCM products.
  • Strategically manage vendor relationships, encompassing platform evaluation, selection, contract negotiation, and ongoing performance oversight.
  • Manage vendor relationships including platform selection, contract negotiation, and performance oversight.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Product Management, Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 7+ years of progressive experience in product management, leading the strategy, development, and launch of complex, large-scale products, preferably within the financial services industry or a similarly regulated, fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in the full product lifecycle management of AI and automation-driven solutions, from conceptual design and strategic planning to successful launch and sustained adoption.
  • Proven ability to strategically prioritize, define, and manage a diverse product roadmap, consistently delivering high-value features and solutions that meet market needs and exceed stakeholder expectations.
  • Strong understanding of global HCM service delivery operations across compensation, benefits, mobility, payroll, and related functions.
  • Exceptional organizational acumen and advanced time management capabilities, adept at navigating complex product interdependencies and driving efficient execution across global, cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with enterprise-grade product management platforms (e.g., Jira), analytics tools, and collaboration software.
  • Superior executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts, influence diverse stakeholders, and present effectively to senior leadership.
  • Highly analytical with advanced strategic problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, capable of identifying root causes, anticipating challenges, and developing innovative solutions.
  • Proven ability to thrive both independently and as a collaborative leader within a matrixed organizational structure, fostering teamwork and accountability.
  • Agile Product Owner/Scrum Master, or other relevant product management certifications are highly desirable.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in HCM technology, service delivery, or enterprise workflow platforms, with hands-on ServiceNow HRSD configuration experience.
  • Expertise in Case Management, Knowledge Management, Employee Center, Service Catalog, Flow Designer, playbooks, and automation.
  • Experience implementing AI-enabled ServiceNow capabilities (predictive intelligence, knowledge recommendations, semantic search).
  • Experience with enterprise HCM systems including Oracle HCM Cloud.

descriptionHtml:
About Gnani.ai-

Gnani.ai is a frontier Voice AI company, building best-in-class AI models and agentic AI platforms that solve problems at scale. Our proprietary stack — speech recognition, text-to-speech, small language models, and agentic voice platforms across 40+ languages — powers real-time conversations in production for some of the most demanding enterprises in the world.

We own our stack end to end. That is our moat — and product is how we turn that depth into experiences customers and developers love.


The Role-

We are hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the organization that builds and runs our voice platform — the real-time runtime, the product surfaces on top of it, and the cloud and telephony infrastructure that keep it fast and reliable under enterprise load.This is a senior, deeply technical leadership role reporting to the Chief Product & Engineering Officer

.You will set engineering strategy, scale a multi-team organization, and stay close enough to the system to own the hard calls on architecture, latency, and reliability yourself. Our AI research organization owns the models; a separate Delivery organization owns customer implementations. Your mandate is to make the platform something both of them can build on with total confidence.


What You'll Own-

• The real-time voice platform & runtime — the orchestration layer where telephony, speech, and agentic logic meet, engineered for low latency and high concurrency.

• Product engineering — the teams building our agentic voice platform, our voice and speech products, and a growing speech-analytics product.

• Infrastructure, DevOps & telephony — Kubernetes-based cloud infrastructure, the VoIP/telephony stack, observability, release engineering, and security operations.

• Reliability & scale — SLAs, on-call, incident response, capacity and concurrency provisioning, and cost-efficient operation at the platform layer.

• Quality & test engineering — test strategy, test automation, and release quality across the product pods, with QA embedded close to the teams it serves

• The engineering organization — hiring, structure, manager development, the technical bar, and engineering culture, partnering with a Principal Architect who holds cross-product technical authority.


What We're Looking For

-You are a sitting engineering leader at an enterprise SaaS or high-growth product company, and you have built and scaled engineering organizations that ship demanding software in production.


Core — what matters more

• 15+ years in software engineering, with several years leading at Director / Sr. Director / VP level at a product company.

• Has personally architected and scaled distributed, low-latency or real-time systems in production— and can still go deep with the strongest engineers.

• A track record of scaling an engineering org through growth: hiring senior talent, managing managers and technical leaders, and raising the bar without slowing delivery.

• Strong cloud-native and reliability depth — Kubernetes, observability, on-call/incident discipline, capacity and cost management at scale.

• Enterprise-grade instincts — multi-tenancy, security, and operating under real customer SLAs and compliance obligations.

• Partners cleanly with peer AI and Product leaders, keeping ownership boundaries crisp.


Strong advantage — what sets a candidate apart

• Building or operating GenAI / agentic-AI platforms comparable to ours.

• Real-time communications, streaming, media, or voice — SIP/RTP, telephony, VAD, ASR/TTS orchestration.

• Running LLM / agentic systems in production.

• Familiarity with the Indian enterprise market and its regulatory environment (DPDP, RBI, IRDAI,TRAI, and HIPAA-type regimes).

• Exposure to multilingual / Indic products.

A note on the bar: deep voice-AI or model-research experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. We are looking first for an exceptional, scaled, hands-on engineering leader.


Skills & Competencies-

• Hands-on engineering — still writes and reviews production code; fluent in one or more modern backend languages (e.g. Go, Python, Rust, Java) and sets the bar by example.

• System architecture & design — strong command of design principles, patterns, and trade-off analysis; clean service boundaries and well-considered APIs (REST / gRPC / streaming).

• Distributed systems at scale — designing and operating low-latency, high-concurrency backend services.

• Event-driven & streaming architectures — message buses and pub/sub (e.g. Kafka, NATS), async and stream processing, queueing, and backpressure.

• SQL & NoSQL databases — sound data-modelling judgement, choosing the right store, and tuning for scale; plus caching and in-memory stores (e.g. Redis).

• Cloud-native engineering — Kubernetes, containers, microservices, and infrastructure-as

-code.• Reliability engineering — SLAs / SLOs, observability, on-call and incident management, capacity and cost planning.

• Performance & efficiency — profiling and optimising latency and cost at the platform and serving layers.

• Enterprise-grade software — security, multi-tenancy, and data protection by design.

• Advantageous — real-time media and telephony (SIP / RTP / WebRTC, VAD, ASR/TTS orchestration), and serving LLM / agentic systems in production.


Leadership & operating-

• Scaling organisations — building and structuring multi-team engineering groups through growth.

• Talent — hiring senior engineers and developing engineering managers.

• Leading leaders — has directly managed technical leadership — Architects, Engineering Managers, and QA leads — not only individual contributors.

• Technical bar & governance — setting standards, owning architecture decisions, and making the hard calls.

• Cross-functional partnership — working cleanly with AI, Product, and Delivery leaders.

• Strategy to delivery — translating business goals into engineering roadmaps and predictable execution.


Why This Role-

The platform is real, in production, and growing — this is a scaling challenge, not a greenfield bet. You will inherit a capable team and a clear mandate, with the CPEO sponsoring the function directly through your onboarding. If you want to own the engineering of a category-defining, India-first voice-AI platform and build the organization that scales it, this is the seat.

Company Overview

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.

  • We have recently been ranked #2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid-Sized Companies, ranked #3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top-Rated Financial Services Companies.
  • We provide best-in-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work-life integration and overall well-being.
  • We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities, focusing on Advancing Diverse Talent to take up leadership roles.

Organizational Overview

The Desktop Engineering function is accountable for engineering, automating, and securing Synchrony’s end-user compute platforms across Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, and Virtual Desktop environments (e.g., Citrix / Horizon / AWS WorkSpaces / Cloud PC). The team drives modern endpoint management using Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and co-management (SCCM), with strong ownership of software packaging, patch orchestration, OS lifecycle management, endpoint configuration standards, and performance telemetry

Role Summary/Purpose

We are seeking a Desktop Engineering Leader to own and modernize Synchrony’s global endpoint ecosystem across physical and virtual platforms. This leader will partner closely with Risk & Compliance to support audits, ensure configuration compliance, and remediate vulnerabilities, while collaborating with Desktop Operations/ECC teams to enable scalable, reliable day-to-day delivery and support.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Engineering & Platform Lifecycle

  • Lead engineering design, development, standardization, and lifecycle management for Windows, macOS, and ChromeOS endpoints.
  • Engineer and maintain enterprise OS images (Windows/macOS) and govern ChromeOS management and update strategy.
  • Define and maintain hardware standards, perform OEM model testing, and manage drivers/BIOS/firmware update processes.
  • Develop and optimize configuration baselines, performance settings, and endpoint hardening standards across platforms.

Modern Endpoint Management (Intune / Autopilot / SCCM Co-Management)

  • Design and manage Intune policies for configuration, application deployment, compliance, and security baselines.
  • Lead Windows Autopilot workflows including device registration, profile assignment, join models (Hybrid/Azure AD), validation, and reset/reprovisioning processes.
  • Support SCCM infrastructure for co-management scenarios, packaging, patching, and deployment pipelines.
  • Drive strategy/roadmap across endpoint tooling including Intune, SCCM, Ivanti, Tanium, JAMF, and Google Admin Console.

VDI / DaaS Engineering

  • Optimize performance, patching, and application compatibility for VDI/DaaS platforms (e.g., Citrix Cloud, AWS WorkSpaces, AppStream, Cloud PC).
  • Support specialized VDI requirements (M365 Products & Services on Citrix).

Security, Risk, Compliance, and Audit Support

  • Knowledge of audit/control expectations as applied to endpoints (e.g., SOX, PCI, configuration compliance).
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration (Operations, Security, Risk, Cloud, Network).
  • Excellent documentation and communication skills; ability to lead RCA and corrective action programs.
  • Broad hands-on/architectural experience across Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, SCCM, Intune, JAMF, Citrix/VDI.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience leading Cloud PC / DaaS programs and VDI modernization/migration initiatives.
  • Track record delivering large-scale endpoint lifecycle modernization (e.g., Autopilot adoption, OS lifecycle planning).

We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.

Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

descriptionHtml:
About the Company


Techlabs Semiconductor Private Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary company of Trident Techlabs Limited, a leading provider of semiconductor services offering comprehensive end-to-end solutions across design, verification, validation, testing, Systems Design, manufacturing and AI. We serve a diverse range of industries, including Consumer Electronics, Automotive, Semiconductor, Telecommunications, Defence, Armed forces and Industrial Automation.


Role Summary

The VP / Head of Engineering will provide strategic, technical, and operational leadership across semiconductor and system-level design services. This role is responsible for driving engineering excellence, scalable delivery, product innovation, and customer success across end-to-end silicon and systems programs.

The ideal candidate brings 20+ years of experience spanning semiconductor product development and engineering services, with deep exposure to customer-facing delivery, global teams, and P&L-aligned execution.


Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Technology Leadership

  • Define and execute the engineering strategy and technology roadmap aligned with company growth objectives.
  • Lead end-to-end engineering across:
  • ASIC / SoC / FPGA design
  • Analog, mixed-signal, and digital design
  • Embedded software, firmware, and system design
  • Verification, validation, DFT, physical design, and silicon bring-up
  • Drive adoption of best-in-class engineering processes, tools, and quality frameworks.

Product & Services Execution

  • Oversee product-oriented and services-led engineering programs, ensuring on-time, on-budget delivery.
  • Balance custom design services, platform-based solutions, and reusable IP strategies.
  • Partner with Product Management to shape solution offerings and differentiation for target markets.

Customer & Business Engagement

  • Act as a technical executive interface for key customers, including design reviews, escalations, and roadmap discussions.
  • Support pre-sales, proposals, and technical due diligence, contributing to deal shaping and closure.
  • Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction, retention, and repeat business.

Organizational Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and retain high-performing global engineering teams across multiple geographies.
  • Establish clear career paths, leadership development, and succession planning.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Operational Excellence & Governance

  • Own engineering KPIs related to quality, productivity, utilization, and delivery predictability.
  • Manage budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation aligned with business priorities.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards, security requirements, and customer quality expectations.


Required Experience & Qualifications

Experience

  • 20+ years of experience in semiconductor and systems engineering, with a strong mix of:
  • Product development
  • Engineering / design services delivery
  • Proven leadership at Director, Senior Director, or VP level managing large, multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated success in scaling engineering organizations in a services or hybrid product-services environment.
  • Strong background working with global customers (fabless companies, OEMs, hyperscalers, or Tier-1s).

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of SoC/ASIC lifecycle, from architecture to silicon qualification.
  • Strong system-level perspective including hardware-software co-design.
  • Familiarity with advanced nodes, IP ecosystems, and EDA workflows is highly desirable.

Leadership & Business Skills

  • Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline.
  • Excellent communication and executive presence, both internal and customer-facing.
  • Proven ability to influence across engineering, sales, product, and executive teams.


Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • MBA or advanced management education is a plus.

Job Description

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in the Product Management team to partner with the Business.

As a Vice President of Product Management in wholesale lending services team, you will lead the strategy and delivery of digital solutions that transform our wholesale lending business.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve product vision, multi-year strategy, and roadmap, aligning to business priorities, regulatory/controls requirements, and customer outcomes.
  • Lead people management: hire, coach, develop, and performance-manage product talent; set operating cadence, standards, and career growth plans.
  • Establish and run program governance (operating model, decision forums, intake/prioritization, dependency management, risk/issue management, and execution reporting).
  • Provide data insights for leadership: define KPI frameworks/OKRs, build executive-level dashboards, translate metrics into narrative, and drive decisions with evidence.
  • Direct solution discovery with cross-functional partners (engineering, design, data, operations, controls) to identify scalable solutions and validate value.
  • Lead product planning and delivery across portfolios/releases—ensuring scope clarity, sequencing, and timely launches with measurable benefits.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and controls to define target-state workflows, requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and customer value.
  • Apply Agile-at-scale practices to improve throughput and predictability; remove impediments and manage trade-offs across competing priorities.
  • Drive change management and end-user adoption: stakeholder mapping, comms/training plans, enablement materials, feedback loops, and adoption measurement.
  • Ensure quality and readiness through test management and automation, production verification, and post-release monitoring; drive continuous improvement via root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering to ensure secure, resilient delivery and alignment to architecture, data, and platform standards.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, IT, or related field
  • Demonstrated leadership as a VP/Senior Product Manager/Product Lead delivering digital transformation in financial services (wholesale lending).
  • Strong understanding of wholesale lending processes, digital technologies, and risk/controls considerations in regulated environments.
  • Proven people leadership experience (managing PM/PO teams), including coaching, operating cadence, and talent development.
  • Strong change management capability to drive adoption and measure behavior change/outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, organization, and presentation skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and Agile tooling (e.g., Jira/Confluence or equivalent).

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Expertise across the product lifecycle: discovery → delivery → launch → adoption → optimization.
  • Strong data literacy: KPI/OKR design, dashboarding, insight generation, and executive storytelling to influence decisions.
  • Experience leading program governance and cross-functional execution across multiple workstreams and dependencies.

descriptionHtml:
Who Are We?

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

Role Overview

The Chief of Staff, Product is a high-impact, high-trust role at the center of RZR's product organization. You will work as a direct partner to the VP of Product — not as a scheduler or note-taker, but as an operator and force multiplier who translates roadmap direction into clear plans, owned milestones, and measurable outcomes.

You will work across Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, and Finance, removing execution friction, improving decision quality, and ensuring the organisation stays focused on its highest-leverage product work. You'll own the product operating cadence end-to-end, build executive materials for board and leadership reviews, run deep-dive analyses when needed, and step in directly to drive critical initiatives from problem definition through delivery.

The ideal candidate is a sharp operator and analytical thinker who is genuinely comfortable in ambiguity, can hold their own in any cross-functional room, and cares deeply about outcomes — not activity or optics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end execution of high-priority product and cross-functional initiatives, from problem definition through delivery and follow-through
  • Translate roadmap direction and product strategy into clear plans, milestones, ownership structures, and success metrics
  • Partner with leaders across Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, Finance, and People to manage dependencies and ensure timely delivery
  • Own the product operating cadence: roadmap reviews, quarterly and sprint planning, OKR tracking, and executive product reviews
  • Build structured analyses, decision memos, and business cases to support product leadership in high-stakes decisions
  • Run product and usage deep dives directly when needed to unblock decisions or accelerate outcomes
  • Prepare leadership materials for product reviews, board discussions, and strategic planning cycles
  • Track progress against product priorities and ensure decisions are documented, communicated, and executed across the organisation
  • Step in flexibly to cover execution gaps on critical product initiatives as business needs evolve

Required Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
  • 5+ years in Chief of Staff, Product Operations, Strategy, Business Operations, Consulting, Program Management, or Product Management — ideally in or adjacent to a product organisation
  • Proven track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced, high-growth environments
  • Strong analytical skills: structuring ambiguous problems, interpreting product and usage data, and translating insight into action
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with experience creating executive-ready materials for senior leadership and boards
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority across senior cross-functional partners
  • High ownership and bias to action; comfort managing multiple competing priorities with limited direction
  • Nice to have: experience in technology, ad tech, or product-led businesses; familiarity with product analytics, roadmapping, or OKR frameworks; MBA or advanced degree

Why Join RZR?

  • Direct seat at the table on product strategy — you'll partner daily with VP-level product leadership on the decisions that shape RZR's roadmap and future
  • Unmatched cross-functional exposure across Engineering, Design, GTM, Finance, and executive leadership, including board-level visibility from day one
  • A genuine force-multiplier role with real, organisation-wide ownership — your work will be visible at every level, not buried in a support function
  • High-trust, high-autonomy environment where outcomes matter more than titles or process — no bureaucracy, no busywork
  • Scaling a profitable, post-turnaround ad tech company into its next phase of operational and product maturity — you'll help define how the org runs
  • Clear growth path into product management, product operations, or general management for the right person

RZR Behaviors

RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership

  • Move Fast
  • Drive for Excellence
  • Proactive Communication
  • Courage
  • Curiosity
  • Deliver Results
  • Manage Ambiguity

Your impact will be shaping how customers harness Teradata’s VantageCloud and data warehouse capabilities through AI-driven insights, automation, and intelligent applications. Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions optimized for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, unlocking measurable customer value while ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency of AI workloads. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of AI initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives. This role reports to the VP of Product Management and will partner closely with product engineering and platform leaders worldwide.  You will act as the strategic AI product leader for Teradata, influencing global product direction. Deep technical expertise in AI/ML concepts, including LLMs, foundation models, supervised/unsupervised learning, fine-tuning, inference pipelines, and multi-modal AI. Proven success embedding AI into enterprise-scale platforms, especially in data management, analytics, or cloud environments. Strong technical fluency with AI infrastructure — including distributed training, inference optimization, GPU/accelerator integration, and workload orchestration. Experience defining APIs, SDKs, and developer integrations for enterprise AI adoption. Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on AI performance, scalability, and cost optimization. Familiarity with governance and compliance frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2) and applying them to AI/ML solutions. Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders and articulate AI product strategy. Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking in enterprise software. Hands-on knowledge of GPU, TPU, and emerging accelerator technologies for training, inference, and fine-tuning AI models. Ability to bridge AI model development with structured and unstructured enterprise data at petabyte scale. A strong understanding of responsible AI, including fairness, explainability, auditability, and bias detection. Vision to anticipate industry trends and position Teradata’s AI offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready. Passion for enabling intuitive, AI-powered user experiences (e. g. , natural language query, automated insights, intelligent automation). In this role, you will serve as a senior Products leader driving Teradata’s AI product management strategy across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata integrates AI/ML technologies into our enterprise-scale data and analytics platforms.

Your impact will be shaping how customers harness Teradata’s VantageCloud and data warehouse capabilities through AI-driven insights, automation, and intelligent applications. You will set the roadmap for embedding AI into mission-critical workloads, balancing innovation with performance, governance, and compliance.

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions optimized for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, unlocking measurable customer value while ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency of AI workloads.

Who You Will Work With

On our team, we collaborate with engineering, cloud infrastructure, data science, UX, and governance functions to bring next-generation AI capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of AI initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.

This role reports to the VP of Product Management and will partner closely with product engineering and platform leaders worldwide. You will act as the strategic AI product leader for Teradata, influencing global product direction.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years leading AI/ML or advanced analytics products.
  • Deep technical expertise in AI/ML concepts, including LLMs, foundation models, supervised/unsupervised learning, fine-tuning, inference pipelines, and multi-modal AI.
  • Proven success embedding AI into enterprise-scale platforms, especially in data management, analytics, or cloud environments.
  • Strong technical fluency with AI infrastructure — including distributed training, inference optimization, GPU/accelerator integration, and workload orchestration.
  • Experience defining APIs, SDKs, and developer integrations for enterprise AI adoption.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on AI performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
  • Familiarity with governance and compliance frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2) and applying them to AI/ML solutions.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders and articulate AI product strategy.
  • Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking in enterprise software.

What You Will Bring

  • Expertise in optimizing AI workloads across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring cost-efficiency and performance at scale.
  • Hands-on knowledge of GPU, TPU, and emerging accelerator technologies for training, inference, and fine-tuning AI models.
  • Ability to bridge AI model development with structured and unstructured enterprise data at petabyte scale.
  • A strong understanding of responsible AI, including fairness, explainability, auditability, and bias detection.
  • Vision to anticipate industry trends and position Teradata’s AI offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.
  • Passion for enabling intuitive, AI-powered user experiences (e. g. , natural language query, automated insights, intelligent automation).
  • Ability to operate as a senior leader — setting strategy, guiding technical direction, and influencing globally.

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
